provenance.source: pypsa-greece generate_seasonal_snapshots.py monthly representative-day selection, weighted to 8760h/yr

provenance.source: Greece NECP 2024 final update (2030 electrolyzer capacity objective 231 MW and 2030 H2 production pilot target 0.92 TWh, divided to an implied utilization factor)
provenance.transformation: hydrogen_target_mwh = real fixed fleet capacity_mw * NECP-implied utilization (0.4546) * 8760h. This demonstration run sizes non-heating H2 final demand at the real fleet's realistic output under the NECP's own implied utilization, not an independently invented target.
